purpose: Provide a bounded Event Viewer-style chronology for production, changeover, operator, telemetry, CMMS, maintenance, LineAlert concern, trial, recommendation, and recovery events on the same synthetic calendar as the Plant Canvas.

event_record.structured_fields: Event-specific fields preserve related incident/work-order identifiers and bounded context without converting sequence into causation.
event_record.supersession_rule: Corrections should supersede prior records rather than silently rewrite them in a production implementation.

roll_change_context.recorded_preceding_event: Label roll replaced and changeover record completed
roll_change_context.relationship_semantics: The roll-change record may be shown as recent context only when the synthetic event exists before the concern timestamp.
roll_change_context.boundary: preceded by change != caused by change

browser_demo_retention.generated_history: Rendered on demand for the selected time window rather than appended indefinitely.
browser_demo_retention.boundary: Bounded browser display is not a production retention policy or evidence deletion rule.

boundaries: recovery observed != root cause proof or future reliability guarantee
